source: Public guides compiled 2026-11-23 (metabot, timesaver, allthings, aion2hub; see docs/FIELD-BOSSES.md). The NPC ids come from the client export (WorldMapFieldNamed -> NpcData, tools/data/field-boss-guide.json 'npcs' are checked against tools/data/field-bosses.json by FieldBossGuideTests). Timers and schedules are GUIDE values for the Global/EU service after the 2026-11-04 patch, not client data: the client has no respawn period (WorldMapFieldNamed.PeriodSpawnId names a server table).

confidence.confirmed: two or more guide sources agree, or a game-file based site (metabot) says so

server_utc_offset_note: GUESS: Global shares one clock, believed to be UTC+9 (community-derived, not official). Aion:FieldBosses:ServerUtcOffsetHours overrides it.
spawn_window_note: LIKELY (timesaver, redwendy): after the countdown ends the boss can appear at any point in the next ~10 minutes. Added to every guide after-kill timer, at the kill.

timers.name: Eternal Gartua
timers.note: 11 h after the kill (12 h before the Global 2026-11-04 patch). Lv 51, Hero, Natura, attacks on sight. MB-x, MB-KO, TS.

timers.name: Immortal Gartua
timers.note: Altgard's Gartua: same drop table and (probably) the same skills (the client NpcData lists the same nine). MB-WB, MB-KO, TS.

timers.name: High Commander Lagta
timers.note: 11 h after the kill (Global 2026-11-04). KR history 24 h -> 12 h (2025-12-17). Lv 48. MB-x, ATH-T, RW, TS.

timers.name: Silent Dartan
timers.note: 6 h after the kill (ATH-T; metabot shows no timer). Lv 48. The Altgard row is NpcData M_D1_FieldBoss_BeritraD_01_001 (guide: Basfelt Ruins).

timers.name: Soul Ruler Kashapa
timers.note: 6 h after the kill (ATH-T). Lv 48. MB-x.

titles.name: Argo, the Spirit King
titles.note: GUESS which of the two EleKing_V02 rows (…_001 / …_002, Siel's Wings archipelago) is the Spirit King and which the Executor; both are level 65 grade 2.

titles.name: Watcher Kaira
titles.note: Six placements in the client MapData (the guide: one of 6 random points per spawn).

titles.name: Executor Kaira
titles.note: The single placement of the other BeritraD row (guide: Sulfur Tree Island).

titles.name: Guardian Lord Nahma
titles.note: M_AR1_RR_AbBoss_01_001..003: three placements (guide: Reshanta's Root, Devastated Remnants, Black Fragments).

titles.name: Executor Tamasa
titles.note: GUESS: the one remaining level-65 Abyss named row (Radvima_01_CV02) for the third executor.

titles.name: Enraged Guardian Lord Nahma
titles.note: M_AR3_AbBoss_01_002/003, Middle Reshanta, two placements (guide: 2 spawns).

titles.name: Turncoat Ducal
titles.note: The only Middle row whose client skills match the guide's game-file list: instant ranged strike (1808240), a 1.5 s skill with a 2 s abnormal (1808250) and a 2 s cast (1808270).

schedules.note: Global: every 3 h from 01:00 server time (MB-WB, AH, TS). KR/TW differ (every 4 h from 00:00 since 2026-09-02). One of the 6 client placements each time (MB-x, ATH-T, AH-0902).
Global every 12 h (MB-WB, TS). KR fixes it at 09:00/21:00 since 2026-10-28 (INV-2371).
Global Friday and Sunday 21:00 (MB-WB, ATH-N, TS); the three placements spawn together.
Global 30 minutes after the Artifact Siege (Thursday and Saturday since 2026-11-04; Monday dropped). MB-WB, TS, ATH-K. Tamasa's NPC id is a GUESS (see titles).
Middle Reshanta, Global Friday and Sunday 21:00 (MB-WB, ATH-M).

Executioner Dramos, Ravager Marakha, Turncoat Ducal: Global Monday, Thursday and Saturday 21:30 (MB-WB, ATH-M; metabot's row may be outdated). Which of 2600520/2600522 is Dramos and which Marakha is unknown (no client strings), so only Ducal has a title.

gaps: The 20 + 19 Lv 45 zone bosses have no published timer (except Melted Danar, 1 h) and the client carries no English titles to map the guide names to NpcData rows: they keep the 1.5-6 h named window.
Melted Danar (1 h after the kill) cannot be tied to an NpcData row.
Eltnen/Morheim Lv 80 bosses (2101600, 2101601, 2406990, 2406991 and the Lv 80 named rows): names and levels only, no timers.
Kaira / Argo / Nahma are not despawned if nobody kills them before the next slot (despawn time unknown); a killed boss returns at the next slot.
The kill achievements, titles and loot of the guide are not part of this file (loot tables are their own data).
